title_en: Light emitting diode (LED) display screen release terminal of prewarning information based on common alerting protocol (CAP) specification standard
abstract_en: The invention provides a light emitting diode (LED) release terminal used for receiving and transmitting prewarning information based on a common alerting protocol (CAP) specification standard. The release terminal comprises a terminal hardware and software system and four main function modules, namely a message engine module, a system integrating module, a converged communication module and a security authentication encryption module, wherein the message engine module subscribes to and resolves an international standard warning CAP format; the system integrating module is used for integrating the original established release systems; the converged communication module adopts a standard transmission protocol and strategy; and the safe design of the security authentication encryption module adopts a class-five security architecture system when terminal equipment subscribes to message releasing service. The LED release terminal aims to integrate conventional release terminals, the resolving of a standard prewarning message and an output way of template contents which are easily customized are provided, and directional release of various LED off-line electronic display screens and on-line electronic display screens is realized; and the cost can be greatly reduced by integrating the systems and using established system equipment.

title_en: CAP specification standard-based multimedia distribution terminal for pre-warning infromation
abstract_en: The invention provides a CAP (Common Alerting Protocol) specification standard-based multimedia distribution terminal for pre-warning information. The multimedia distribution terminal comprises terminal hardware and a software system operating on the terminal hardware, as well as a message engine module, a media adaptation module, a system integration module, a confluence communication module and a safety certification and encryption module, wherein the message engine module achieves subscription and analysis in international standard warning CAP protocol format; the media adaptation module adapts various terminal display screens; the system integration module is used for integrating the conventional and constructed distribution systems; the confluence communication module adopts a standard transmission protocol and strategy; and the safety certification and encryption module adopts a five-level safety architecture system. The multimedia distribution terminal aims to integrate the conventional distribution terminal, provides analytical and easily customized template content output manner of a standard pre-warning message, and solves the multimedia directional distribution problem. Through the system integration, the cost can be greatly reduced by utilizing the constructed system devices.

title_en: Early warning information mass-sending decision-making method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a device for making a decision on mass-sending early warning information, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The early warning information mass sending decision method comprises the following steps: responding to the received early warning information, and extracting elements of the early warning information based on a plurality of preset element dimensions to obtain multi-dimensional early warning elements; querying a target group matched with the multidimensional early warning elements from a plurality of preset release groups; calculating the required release capacity of the early warning information based on the multi-dimensional early warning elements to determine matched release channels based on the required release capacity; and mapping the early warning information to a matched release template based on the multidimensional early warning elements, and generating information to be released so as to release the information to be released to a target group through a matched release channel. Through the technical scheme of the disclosure, key information can be ensured to arrive at a target group in time, so that the accuracy and pertinence of information release are improved, and better user experience is provided.
assignees: CMA PUBLIC METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTRE NAT EARLY WARNING INFORMATION PUBLISHING CENTER

title_en: Visualized data information acquisition system based on big data and medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visualized data information acquisition system based on big data and a medium thereof, in particular to the field of electronic commerce, the system comprises a data encryption acquisition module, a data cleaning and integrating module, a data analysis module, a real-time data monitoring module, a visual template customizing module and a dynamic data interaction module. The visualized data information acquisition system based on big data and the medium thereof encrypt target platform data through a data encryption acquisition module to reduce hidden danger of data acquisition, perform real-time data processing operation through a real-time data monitoring module, set a data change rule and an early warning mechanism, acquire and update data in time, receive third key information through a dynamic data interaction module, display the third key information on a visualized interface according to a preset mode, provide autonomous exploration and prediction analysis of dynamic data by a user, and increase interactivity of the system.
